agents.description: Recommends controlled vocabularies, ontologies and data formats from FAIRsharing for a dataset profile, grounded on the registry records it retrieved. Ranking rules choose first; a model may add records it found and note doubts, never remove one.

json_schema.$comment: Generated from standards.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to standards.yaml>`. Do not edit.

CategoryCount.description: One category of a field and how many rows hold it, rounded.
CategoryCount.title: CategoryCount

DisclosureCheck.description: What the disclosure check of a field's summary values did: the rules, their parameters, the tool and how many values it left out, never which (docs/specs/personal-data.md).

check_rounding_base.description: The base counts were rounded to.

check_rules.description: The rules applied, such as minimum threshold, k-th value range, p-ratio, nk dominance, zeros disclosive and rounding.

check_suppressed.description: How many of the field's summary values were left out. Never which.

check_tool.description: The output checker that applied the rules, such as acro.

DisclosureCheck.title: DisclosureCheck

FieldSummary.description: Summary values of one table field that the inventory command computed where the data live and passed through statistical disclosure control before writing (docs/specs/personal-data.md). A value that failed a rule is absent, never altered to pass; every count is at least the check's threshold and rounded to its base, and a range is never the raw minimum and maximum.

summary_categories.description: The field's categories that at least k rows hold, with their counts. Rarer categories are left out and counted in check_suppressed.

summary_mean.description: The mean of a numeric field's values, missing-value codes left out, written only when the threshold and dominance rules pass.

summary_missing_codes.description: Values the field holds that are often used for missing data (-99, -999, 999, 9999, NA, N/A, NaN, null, .), each held by at least k rows, with their counts.

summary_null_count.description: How many of the rows read hold no value in the field, rounded.

summary_range_high.description: The upper bound of the field's values, the k-th largest, as summary_range_low.

summary_range_low.description: The lower bound of the field's values: the k-th smallest, so that at least k rows (the check's threshold) lie at or below it. A number or an ISO 8601 date or time, as text.

summary_rows_read.description: How many rows were read to compute the summaries, rounded.

FieldSummary.title: FieldSummary

MissingCodeCount.description: A value that a field may use for missing data, such as -99 or NA, and how many rows hold it, rounded.
MissingCodeCount.title: MissingCodeCount

TableField.description: One field of a tabular resource, mirroring a Frictionless Table Schema field descriptor. Frictionless publishes no RDF namespace, so these slots carry see_also rather than a slot_uri (TODO(#20): revisit if Frictionless publishes term IRIs).

field_disclosure_check.description: The disclosure check the field's summary values passed. Present whenever field_summary is.

field_summary.description: The field's summary values (docs/specs/personal-data.md). Absent, no summaries were made: by an older command, in a runtime where they do not run, or with them turned off.

field_type.description: Frictionless field type (string, number, integer, boolean, date, datetime, time, duration, geopoint, ...).

TableField.title: TableField

json_schema.description: A minimal description of a dataset being planned or prepared: what it is about and how it is shaped. Every slot maps onto an external vocabulary rather than a Data Director namespace.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

themes.description: Discipline or subject, as free text or an IRI.

json_schema.title: DatasetProfile

json_schema.$comment: Generated from standards.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to standards.yaml>`. Do not edit.

GroundingRef.description: The identity and content hash of one retrieved thing a payload rests on. The only way a payload may name an external resource as a decided identity, and the only place it names it: what the reference identifies is read from the evidence item with the same source_id and content_hash (docs/specs/grounding.md). The linter matches every GroundingRef against a retrieval span on both fields.
GroundingRef.title: GroundingRef

Recommendation.description: One recommended resource for one target. The resource is named only in grounded_on; its name, status and DOI are in the cited evidence item's content (docs/specs/grounding.md).

concern.description: A model's doubt that a record the rules chose suits the dataset. The recommendation is kept; a person decides.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

notes.description: Facts to weigh beside the recommendation, such as that a model chose it.

selection_derivation.description: Who chose the record: lexical, by the ranking rules over the first search, or model, by a model from the records retrieved in the run, its own searches included.

target.description: dataset, or field:<name> for a field-level recommendation.

Recommendation.title: Recommendation

SearchedSummary.description: What was looked for, so a reader can judge an abstention as well as a recommendation.

snapshot_ref.description: Which copy of the registry answered, e.g. snapshot:2026-09-04 or live.

SearchedSummary.title: SearchedSummary

json_schema.description: The standards advisor payload. Recommended vocabularies, ontologies and formats.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

limitations.description: What the advisor does not yet do.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

json_schema.title: Recommendations
